searchText: I have a question regarding EIP 4844 why did you @ everyone Actually I want to ask my question to everyone yeah you still dont @ everyone you just post and wait Ok My question is how can I generate NFTs on EIP 4844 ? its not done yet So it is not possible Can we generate NFT on EIP 4844 in future EIP-4844 is... a bit removed from the concept of NFTs. In the future, roll-ups like Optimism/Arbitrum/zksync/etc will be able to use EIP-4844 to offer cheaper fees to their users, so NFTs on those platforms will be cheaper to use. Ohh Thanks for this important information
